newsitem.title: CHINA: Swire raises price of upmarket property.
newsitem.headline: Swire raises price of upmarket property.

text.p: Swire Properties Ltd will launch the sale of its latest upmarket residential property on Hong Kong island on July 21, company executives said on Friday.
Twenty units will be offered in this phase at an average price of HK$10,823 per sq ft, director Michael Moir said.
The flats, which range in size from 811 sq ft to 1,187 sq ft, will sell for HK$8.78 million to HK$12.85 million per unit.

Swire will offer the first 20 units in the 214-unit, two-tower complex to local residents on Saturday in an attempt to lure homeowners of neighboring Swire-built Taikoo Shing Properties to upgrade, marketing manager Wendy Gan said.
To reduce excessive speculation, the sale will be by ballot and the results will be announced on July 31.

Swire Properties, a wholly owned subsidiary of Swire Pacific Ltd, sold Island Place, another upmarket residential development on Hong Kong island, earlier this year for an average price of HK$10,593 per sq ft, Gan said.
